question: Let $f:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be a differentiable function such that its derivative $f'$ is a continuous function. Moreover, assume that for all $x\in\mathbb R$, $0\le |f'(x)|\le\frac12$. Define a sequence of real numbers $\{a_n\}_{n\in\mathbb N}$ by $a_1=1$, $a_{n+1}=f(a_n)$ for all $n\in\mathbb N$. Prove that there exists a positive real number $M$ such that for all $n\in\mathbb N$, $|a_n|\le M$.
